## Checklist

<!--
  Check every box below before requesting a review.
  Do not edit or remove these items; the "PR checklist" CI job looks for their exact text.
  You may add your own checkboxes below them.
-->

- [ ] Ensure all user-facing text is spell-checked.
- [ ] Bump version in package.json.
- [ ] Update changelog.
- [ ] Update application feature and/or device support metadata (if applicable).
- [ ] Make sure Greg confirmed your PR.
